svg.title: Security and safety
svg.desc: Profile selection, command delivery, scanner adapters, normalized state, compact reads, sanitized evidence, and recovery.

a.xlink:title: publishes validated command (NATS)
updates scan state (SQLite)
selects Quick/Full/App (Python)
runs bounded plan (Subprocess)
records sanitized lifecycle (SQLite/NATS)
durable delivery (JetStream)
runs security work (Python)
defines targets/exclusions (Python)
writes normalized results (SQLite)
sanitized lookup (HTTP)
React / Vite PWA. Renders Lite screens and sends same-origin requests only to FastAPI through Caddy.
Fleet, Apps, Security, Recovery, and Release APIs. Exposes domain-specific read and command endpoints while preserving backend-owned lifecycle execution.
Security scan coordinator. Validates Quick, Full, and App Check requests, tracks active runs, and exposes compact split-read summaries.
Prepared read, health, readiness, diagnostics, and evidence APIs. Serves side-effect-free prepared projections, health/readiness, compact diagnostics, and sanitized evidence lookups.
Security findings and run state. Stores scan runs, tools, progress, findings, profile snapshots, and sanitized evidence references.
NATS / JetStream. Provides the command and event backbone with durable delivery; it is never contacted directly by the frontend.
a.text: is never contacted directly by the...

a.xlink:title: Worker process. Consumes durable commands and owns backend execution for apps, security, recovery, releases, and lifecycle work.
Quick, Full, and App safety checks. Defines bounded profile-specific targets, exclusions, timeouts, coverage summaries, and truthful partial/failed states.
Lynis and Trivy scanner adapters. Run bounded backend-owned scanners with target-aware exclusions and sanitized evidence; the browser never executes scanners.
Completion and audit evidence. Records sanitized lifecycle and completion evidence for commands, devices, apps, security, recovery, and releases.
